rubricScores.criterion: Quantified the per-framework split: net472 carries the large majority (~159, including all 64 FS0039), net10.0 only ~8
Concluded the net472 failures stem from missing .NET-only APIs (MetadataUpdater / AssemblyLoadContext)
Concluded the net10.0 failures are genuine type errors independent of the framework
Stated these are TWO distinct problems, not one
Used the binlog's per-(project, target-framework) attribution as the evidence for the split

scenarios.reasoning: The agent used the binlog tooling competently — locating per-target-framework build nodes and using under()/code filters to partition errors — and recovered gracefully from inaccessible temp-file dumps. The qualitative conclusion (net472 = missing .NET-Core-only APIs with cascading inference errors; net10.0 = genuine source type errors; two distinct problems) is largely correct and well-presented. However, it prematurely narrowed to one project and thus reported 63 of 169 errors, missing the bulk of the FS0039s and MetadataUpdater, so the quantitative breakdown the question explicitly asked for is materially incomplete. Acceptable analysis with a significant scoping gap.
